args.message: I added up revenue (order amounts) by the customer's region. I calculated each region's credit limit separately from the customer table, so each customer counts once, including customers with no orders. Regions by revenue, highest first: North 109,334.76 (credit 35,740), South 104,269.90 (32,650), East 68,738.70 (24,920) and West 49,151.79 (18,020). Orders without a known region make up their own group: 16 orders worth 1,193.30. That group's credit total of 500 is from the one customer with no region. I didn't check whether those 16 orders all belong to that customer or include orders for customer IDs not in the customer table.
